scope: One fixed-default PocketSphinx 5.1.1 host feasibility replay of all350 reused synthetic Mac sources. Not independent, acoustic, P4 or Hi ESP parity acceptance.
pronunciation_policy: Exact two original CMU entries; same Nicks spelling as source intent. No score-based dictionary changes. Pronunciation intent is not phonetic truth.
protocol: Before scoring, authenticate all350 WAV hashes/header geometry and retained Hi ESP PCM CRC. Twice replay each full source with a new Decoder, no LM, exact native keyword defaults. Original prime plus final block zero padding only. Preserve every unique native keyword segment and first observed return block, including prime/flush events.
decision: Single default configuration; no threshold or pronunciation sweep and no fitting. Report all target/text/voice event counts. Storage/native MCU feasibility must be established separately even if host scores look promising.
limits: All350 correlated synthetic sources are reused development; synthesis labels are not verified pronunciations or new human recall.
Retained Hi ESP is P4; PocketSphinx is macOS host with a different frontend. No hardware latency, matched FAR or acoustic comparison follows.
Prime/flush/end-frame conventions differ by decoder. Return samples are observed host call boundaries, not phonetic endpoint latency.
Process peak RSS includes Python, all preloaded source PCM and native overhead. Host compute and memory are not P4 estimates.
Raw acoustic payload is about6.6MB, exceeding current2MiB filesystem even without app, decoder code or GUI assets. No drop-in firmware feasibility assumed.
No final/reserved data, training restart, playback, microphone recording, USB/board/firmware, service, original PCM speed or I2S/AEC/AGC/FIFO changes. Dining-room board excluded.
